description: This file defines a service for handling messaging between an iOS app and a watchOS app using WatchConnectivity. It includes error handling, status reporting, message sending, and delegate implementations for session state changes and message reception.

classes.name: WatchMessagingService
classes.description: A final class that manages messaging between iOS and watchOS devices using WatchConnectivity, including session management, message sending, and receiving replies.

methods.name: isSupportedOnDevice
methods.description: Checks if the current device supports WatchConnectivity sessions.

methods.name: currentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Provides a snapshot of the current messaging status.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current messaging status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to process quick reply events received from the watch.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification payload to the watch, with fallback to transfer user info if unreachable.
